answer: Each new identity posts a refundable bond that unlocks only after four epochs and after it collects countersignatures from three established agents who have not co-signed one another in the prior ten epochs. Clique overlap collapses those signers into one witness, so a replica factory cannot attest itself. The graph check treats a tight pack of identical hosts like grains on one dune, while independent operators remain as separate as stars in a nebula or an island cut off by water. If later execution traces collide, the bond is slashed and sponsors are fined.
